This is more a way for you to help self published authors rather than helping yourself as one, but never discount the helpfulness of a good review. A lot of people won't buy a book that doesn't have any reviews. If you read a book you find here on SelfPublished then don't forget to leave a review on Amazon (or wherever you find it) as well as on here.

 

One tip I've heard other people say, but haven't implemented myself yet, is to not be afraid to ask for reviews. If you like to put acknowledgements or postscripts in your books then include a line like "If you liked this then please leave a review where you found it." One little review can go a long way.

I've gotten plenty of feedback from the people I know, but, yeah, a review of some sort would be amazing.

Another thing to note and always remember; be constructive and detailed with any criticism. Saying "It sucked" or "It was really boring" or even "It was slow at the beginning" doesn't necessarily help new authors. Tell us why it sucks, what about it was boring, or what exactly you mean by slow. If your criticism is polite in nature and actually has a point, I promise you, our feelings will not be hurt.
